summary: OpenGL context handling gained several improvements for WebGL and ANGLE integration: Metal ANGLE now synchronizes with Core Animation transactions using `eglWaitUntilWorkScheduledANGLE`, fixes ensure Metal export and snapshot operations properly synchronize, depth/stencil buffer allocation was optimized, and GL readback paths now use more efficient swizzle operations. Obsolete vertex convention support was removed, and various compatibility issues with ANGLE on Android were resolved.
